MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 100
   C. 50
   D. 10

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 44
   C. 105
   D. 22

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 19
   C. 7
   D. 17

4. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

8. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 22
   D. 77

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

11. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

12. Solve for x: x + 7 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 15
   C. 9
   D. 8

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

14. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

15. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

16. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

17. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

18. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 4

19. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 12

20. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

21. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

22. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

23. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

24. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.25

25. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 81

26. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 73

27. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

28. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

29. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 15
   C. 57
   D. 1

30. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 24
   C. 10
   D. 25

----
